item.title: 'Worst Ever' COP Summit?
item.description: Is this the worst COP summit on record? With limited political leadership, no official US delegation and mounting frustration over bureaucratic delays, questions are being raised about the effectiveness of the climate negotiations. Juan Carlos Beldsoe, a former White House climate adviser under Bill Clinton, described the process as labyrinthine and ultimately dispiriting. France 24's Gavin Lee speaks with climate advocate and six-time COP delegate, Henna Hundal about what this means for the future of global climate action. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: FBI database reportedly hacked
item.description: The FBI is investigating a reported major cyberattack targeting its national law enforcement database, the National Crime Information Center (NCIC), which holds sensitive criminal justice records, including information on fugitives, missing persons, criminal histories and stolen property. President Donald Trump said he had just been briefed on the incident, describing it as “not good”. FRANCE 24’s Fraser Jackson reports from Washington DC. Publicado también por: The Verge, France 24 - English. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Un ataque con drones atribuido a Ucrania incendia un carguero ruso en el golfo de Finlandia
item.description: Un barco de carga de Rusia sufrió un incendio luego de ser alcanzado en aguas internacionales por un ataque con drones en el golfo de Finlandia. Autoridades rusas apuntaron a la autoría de Ucrania, algo que militares finlandeses consideraron "probable". Helsinki reportó el incidente a la OTAN y suspendió temporalmente el tráfico aéreo y marítimo en la zona. En el marco de la guerra, un misil ruso mató a dos personas e hirió a decenas en la ciudad natal de Volodímir Zelenski en Ucrania. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Indiana man paid $9,489 towards condo debt after $9,213 judgment, but court says he still owes more
item.description: Onnie James Florence Jr. encountered significant legal troubles stemming from his failure to pay homeowners' association fees for his condominium in Indiana. After acquiring the unit, he neglected to keep up with payments while residing in Illinois. The Meridian Arch Owners Association successfully secured a default judgment against him for the overdue fees. Despite making a partial payment later, additional fees remained unpaid, prompting ongoing legal action. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
